reason: The text contains a clear passage where the Israelite foremen/people directly confront Moses and Aaron with a complaint. After coming out from Pharaoh's presence, they say to Moses and Aaron: 'Let the Lord look upon you and judge, because you have made us abhorrent in the sight of Pharaoh and in the sight of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us' (וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם יֵ֧רֶא יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם וְיִשְׁפֹּ֑ט). This demonstrates the Hebrew people blaming their leaders for worsening their situation and endangering their lives.
